name: mcp-config-ecc-memory-vault
description: Recommended MCP server config "ecc-memory-vault": Opt-in local ECC Memory Vault shared by Claude, Codex, Hermes, Cursor, OpenCode, and other MCP clients. Replace ECC_MEMORY_HARNESS with this server's lowercase identity; callers cannot override it. Normal search recall is active project+team memory. To permit explicitly requested user scope, the operator may also set ECC_MEMORY_ALLOW_USER_SCOPE=1. Writes are create-only and always unreviewed. Install ECC globally or make its bin available on PATH. Not enabled by default.
